title: Tech Note: Naming Conventions to Simplify Component Development and Use

historical_commentary.text: 4D Insider itself has been superseded by 4D's modern, native component architecture, so the specific public/protected/private mechanics tied to 4D Insider are obsolete, but the broader principle — using clear naming conventions to signal a component's intended public API surface — remains sound software engineering advice applicable to today's 4D components and classes.
related_updates: 4D Insider has been superseded by 4D's modern native component architecture, which handles component packaging and encapsulation differently
